:::{#def-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error

A [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ has as its [estimand](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/estimation.html#def-estimand)
the observed [outcome](#def-outcome) $\Outvar$ of a [new observation](#def-new-observation) with [input](#def-input) $\Predvar$,
not the [conditional mean](#def-cond-expectation-function) of that outcome.
The **prediction error** of $\predfn$ is the prediction minus that outcome:

$$\prederrf{\predfn} \eqdef \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
consider the constant [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$.
Its [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) is $\prederrf{\predfn_1} = 3 - \Outvar$.
This is $3$ when $\Outvar = 0$.
It is $-3$ when $\Outvar = 6$.

:::
